purpose: Generic adherence cues for keeping agents inside governed workflow boundaries. Keep entries project-agnostic: project runtime, host commands, verification contours, and environment details belong in governed project data.

cues.title: Claim work before mutating task state
cues.summary: Mutating task work needs an owned task claim and continuation token before progress or finish actions.
cues.full_text: Before mutating task state, claim or start the task through the governed public workflow and keep the returned continuation token. The token is ownership proof for progress, finish, recovery, and auditable concurrency.

cues.title: Exercise the product-facing surface in practice
cues.summary: When the product-facing agent surface is being evaluated, practical use through that surface complements synthetic tests.
cues.full_text: Synthetic or formal tests verify code behavior in isolation. Practical product-surface validation is a later complementary stage: exercise the agent-facing public workflow itself to evaluate discoverability, receipts, next-safe-action guidance, ownership, cues, and adherence. Keep practical evidence distinct from formal verification.

cues.title: Record workflow drift as experience
cues.summary: Observed adherence failures should become experience evidence for later learning and hygiene, not silent chat-only corrections.
cues.full_text: When an agent bypasses governed workflow, skips ownership proof, confuses evidence classes, or validates the product-facing surface through the wrong channel, record the incident as experience so the system can learn and surface better cues later.
